mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_cancellation_completion( order_id,customer_id,actor_id,reason,trigger_source,scheduled_task_id ) VALUES(#{orderId},#{customerId},#{actorId},#{reason},#{triggerSource},#{scheduledTaskId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT order_id,customer_id,actor_id,reason,trigger_source,scheduled_task_id FROM order_cancellation_completion WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND completed_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_cancellation_completion SET completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND completed_at IS NULL
UPDATE order_cancellation_completion SET next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND completed_at IS NULL
